name: Bob Jenkins
title: The Salesman
ability:
At any time, an investigator at your location may reveal to you the [[Item]] assets in their hand.
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play an [[Item]] asset from the hand of an investigator at your location, under their control. (Both investigators may spend resources to pay its cost).
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each [[Item]] asset you control.
ability_cn:
在任何时候，你所在地点的调查员可以向你揭示其手中的[[道具]]支援卡。
在你回合中，你可以进行一个额外行动，该行动只能用于打出你所在地点调查员手中的一张[[道具]]支援卡，置于该调查员控制之下(双方调查员都可以花费资源来支付其费用)。
[elder_sign]效果：你每控制1张[[道具]]支援卡，+1。
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Shrewd Dealings, Greed, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：求生者([survivor])等级0，流浪者([rogue])等级1-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其它流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：精明的交易、贪婪、1张随机基础弱点。
